# Released Contract 1 fixtures

These sanitized documents reproduce the public response shapes documented and
implemented by irlume v0.7.0 Machine API Contract 1. They were checked against
`/usr/share/irlume/schemas/machine-api-v1.schema.json` and the public fixed
commands on 2026-07-28.

Values are synthetic. The fixtures contain no real username, profile name,
camera/device path, image, embedding, credential, password, TPM secret, or
biometric material.
